allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Pursuant to the allotment of equity shares by Triveni Power Transmission Ltd. (TPTL) on July 28, 2026, to the eligible shareholders of the Company as on the record date of July 22, 2026, in accordance with the share entitlement ratio under the Scheme, the Company's holding in TPTL was diluted to 29.88%. Consequently, TPTL ceased to be a subsidiary and became an associate of the Company. Accordingly, Triveni Power Transmission GmbH also ceased to be a step-down subsidiary of the Company.
